claims.content: Allow a customer to create a membership account by providing minimum required information so they can place bids on the website.

goal.raw_text: Allow a customer to create a membership account by providing minimum required information so they can place bids on the website.

claims.content: Customer
The Consumer Protection negative file must be available for cross-referencing to prevent undesirable customers from opening new accounts.
The customer clicks the 'Register Now' button or link on the website.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks the 'Register Now' button or link on the website.

claims.content: The customer accesses the first registration page which collects minimum required information (First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Password, Member ID) to create an account.
The system validates that the email address is unique and the password meets length requirements (8 to 12 characters).
Upon completing the short registration process, the system triggers an automated transactional email with a Thank You message.
The customer proceeds to the second registration page to provide additional information required for shipping winning orders and setting email preferences.
The customer provides valid address, phone number, and credit card information as required to bid and participate in auctions.
The customer may choose to complete only the short registration process (Page 1) and finish providing additional information for the member account process at a later time.

If the system finds a match in the Consumer Protection negative file during registration, the registrant receives an error message stating they are unable to create an auction account at this time and are instructed to contact Customer Service.

If the system finds a match in the Consumer Protection negative file during registration, the registrant receives an error message stating they are unable to create an auction account at this time and are instructed to contact Customer Service.
The customer has successfully created a membership account with minimum required information.
The system has sent an automated transactional email with a Thank You message to the customer.
The customer is able to place bids on the website.
The customer's additional information (address, phone, credit card) is collected for shipping winning orders and setting email preferences (if full registration completed).
